card.source: legacy single-frame path intentionally kept fail-closed (floor=1.0): production card reading must go through the fused pipeline in card_fused, never the legacy corner-glyph matcher

card_fused.algorithm: gray-fused-mlp-v3 (temporal fusion of size-normalized gray glyphs + BGR colour router + per-family MLP)
card_fused.colour_router: BGR (R-B) median over suit-band ink; threshold 30 (corpus bimodal: black=0, red>=35)
card_fused.source: capture_card_calibration_20260903 evidence/field_metrics.json (gray-fused-mlp-v3); suits no longer require any hardware change

note: PARTIAL capture-card profile. Card recognition was calibrated 2026-09-04 by the gray-fused-mlp-v3 pipeline (see AGENTS.md progress log). Earlier verdict that suits were physically unresolvable at 53x78 was reversed: the root causes were the HSV-hue colour router, letterbox jitter in temporal fusion, and suit-label errors, all fixed in software. The seat mapping artifact is landed, and calibration-time seat readers have measured evidence, but the production VisionEngine does not yet load capture-card seat/action recognizers or their per-field calibration blocks. Action-badge recognition is also not wired into the production profile. Those fields must remain UNKNOWN; this profile is not an end-to-end or released capture-card capability.
